note: Proposed slices; status changes require checkpoint evidence. External gates are separate from local implementation dependencies.

tasks.title: Verify baseline and settle shared contracts
tasks.objective: Prepare a reproducible implementation baseline; preserve merged behavior and record the exact integration targets.
implementation: Verify PR #9 ancestry, current integration branch, clean/dirty tree and Alembic head. Locate actual frontend code from its README/remote branches without merging it blindly.

Read current APIs and action/slot/route planning schemas; record proposed API naming, sender scope, default-disabled writes and legacy /draft mapping policy. Keep legacy send stub until safe delegation exists.
Set up Python 3.12+ and backend dev dependencies in an isolated environment. Start an isolated PostgreSQL 16 test DB and run baseline checks; record exact commands/environment.
Create the first committed checkpoint and a concrete migration/PR sequence. No new production endpoint is needed in this task.
acceptance_tests: Run current full backend tests with THREADLY_REQUIRE_TEST_DB=1; investigate any regression from historical 233 baseline, do not force a count.
Run Ruff and both documentation validators; confirm all referenced code paths exist and migration graph has one current head.
Verify known examples still route summary/reply/compose and leave unavailable capabilities explicit; use existing tests, no live provider call needed.
tasks.external_gate: Frontend branch and live deployment state must be discovered, not assumed. Missing cloud credentials do not block local baseline work.
tasks.handoff: B01 can implement capabilities; B02 can implement action storage against the recorded contract. T packages remain partial until their wider criteria pass.

tasks.title: Persist actual Google capabilities and harden auth boundaries
tasks.objective: Expose installed/enabled/granted capabilities and support reconnect without treating requested scopes as granted scopes.
implementation: Extend token response parsing and persistence with actual grants, verified account identity, connection/revocation state and a monotonic capability/account version. Legacy unknown grants stay unknown; do not auto-grant send or Calendar.

Separate token network refresh from caller-owned transactions. Avoid internal commit of unrelated action work; preserve valid refresh tokens when absent in a response and fence concurrent refresh/disconnect.

Inspect actual extension OAuth flow; validate redirect allowlist, state/PKCE responsibility, userinfo identity and email verification before connecting accounts. Do not bolt on incompatible untested auth parameters.
Add GET /assistant/capabilities with implementation/flag/scope/source readiness, and incremental-consent/reconnect contract. Sanitize upstream errors and logs; no raw token endpoint bodies.
Update config/env examples, auth API docs and migration tests. Calendar scope requests must be deliberate; alias/send-as support remains unavailable until verified.
acceptance_tests: Partial grant, absent scope metadata, revoked access and grant reduction never advertise unavailable send/calendar capability.
Refresh without a replacement refresh token preserves the original; concurrent refresh/disconnect cannot restore a revoked connection.
Wrong account subject, invalid redirect, replayed state or failed verifier is rejected according to the actual OAuth integration contract.
Provider error body containing synthetic tokens does not appear in API errors/log capture.
Caller rollback after token retrieval does not accidentally commit an unrelated pending action; migration preserves encrypted legacy tokens.
tasks.external_gate: Google test-account consent/reconnect and deployment redirect configuration require authorized accounts. Record fixture-only results separately.
tasks.handoff: Capability snapshots and token provider interface for B03–B06/B12; AI and frontend receive explicit unavailable reasons.

tasks.title: Add durable action, approval and attempt storage
tasks.objective: Persist external-action state independently of generation jobs and draft review, with ownership and concurrency constraints.
implementation: Implement proposed action/approval/job/attempt tables or consistent model placement in existing models.py. Use composite owned FKs, version/state checks, unique proposal/approval keys and one active dispatch attempt.
Implement pure transition rules and task-first locking helpers; retain exact immutable payload/hash and references. No provider client or external dispatch in this slice.
Coordinate draft edits with pending-action supersession using task → action lock order. After dispatch-intent cutoff, show the old action as possibly executing rather than claiming recall.

Define account/thread deletion handling for in-flight/unknown actions before adding cascading FKs. Keep new dispatch disabled; record minimal reconciliation-retention decision and pending policy gate.
Migration must preserve every existing artifact UUID, review and legacy draft row; refuse destructive downgrade when action history exists.
acceptance_tests: Cross-owner action/approval/attempt insertion fails in service and DB constraints; unknown IDs do not leak existence.
Duplicate proposal keys return one action; same key/different content returns conflict; concurrent transitions serialize.
Illegal state transitions and duplicate active attempts fail; draft edit invalidates pending proposals under the same lock.
Existing 233 baseline cases still run; migration empty/upgrade/drift/downgrade preservation includes edited draft/review rows.
Deleting a source/account cannot silently erase an in-flight action without the coordinated deletion policy being applied.
tasks.external_gate: Deletion/audit policy must be recorded with the team before writes are enabled; it need not prevent fixture-based storage implementation.
tasks.handoff: Owned durable action primitives ready for exact payload construction and approval. External writes remain disabled.

tasks.title: Build immutable MIME payloads and send previews
tasks.objective: Create an inspectable send_email action from the current edited draft without sending it.
implementation: Add the artifact-to-action proposal endpoint with request/revision preconditions. Read artifact.draft_envelope; never use original task recipients after edits.
Build deterministic plain-text MIME with Python email primitives, frozen Date/Message-ID, validated sender/To/Cc/Bcc and safe encoding; persist exact bytes/hash plus user preview.

Validate reply thread identity, References/In-Reply-To chain and source version from owned synced metadata; pin sender/capability versions. If exact headers are unavailable, stop for refresh/rebinding.
Preserve unresolved-fact/placeholder checks, reject unsupported attachments/aliases, and ensure UI distinguishes Mark reviewed from a send preview.
Specify legacy integer draft linkage or keep legacy routes explicit 501; no second independent authority for outgoing content.
acceptance_tests: Editing Bcc/To/body/subject produces a different proposal/hash; replay cannot substitute the original task envelope.
Header injection, Unicode/header folding, duplicate addresses and malformed reply IDs are handled by independent MIME parse assertions.
MIME bytes, Date and Message-ID remain stable across proposal reads/retries; user-visible envelope matches submitted intended recipients.
Stale source or other-owner artifact cannot produce an action; source email instructions cannot create an approval.
Missing headers, unresolved placeholders, unverified sender alias and attachment refs yield explicit blockers, not silently stripped fields.
tasks.external_gate: Controlled Gmail threading/Bcc behavior must be verified before public sending; offline MIME correctness does not establish provider behavior.
tasks.handoff: Exact preview/hash + expiry + source/version envelope available to B04; no HTTP send operation exists here.

tasks.title: Implement explicit approval, rejection and cancellation
tasks.objective: Let a user approve one exact saved action and atomically queue it, with safe replay and stale-state handling.
implementation: Implement GET action, approve/reject/cancel contracts from DESIGN D2 with strict identity/version/hash/request ID checks and expiry policy.
Approval loads stored payload; no replacement action arguments allowed. Persist approval and outbox enqueue in one transaction; revalidate latest draft/context/capability under ordered locks.
Support idempotent retries after outcomes advance; reject changed request bodies. Store events without body, addresses, tokens or full hashes that are unnecessary in logs.
Before dispatch, cancellation/rejection can close pending work. After dispatch intent, record cancellation requested and return honest executing/unknown status.
Keep public approval unavailable until the executor is installed/enabled; exercise internal enqueue with a fake dispatcher. Mark reviewed never implicitly calls approve.
acceptance_tests: Concurrent duplicate approvals produce one approval/job; same key/different hash conflicts; wrong version/hash cannot enqueue.
Approval racing draft edit or expiry is serialized: only the still-valid exact version can be queued.
Queue failure rolls back approval, and approval failure creates no orphan runnable job.
Cross-owner IDs, injected replacement recipients/body, expired/rejected/superseded actions and missing scope fail.
Cancel before dispatch suppresses send; cancel after cutoff cannot report not-sent without evidence.
tasks.external_gate: Frontend must display exact action and use an explicit Send control. No live dispatch until B06 and authorized integration gates.
tasks.handoff: B05 can consume approved jobs with a fake HTTP transport; B18 connects the explicit approval UI.

tasks.title: Implement the Gmail executor with writes disabled
tasks.objective: Execute stored approved MIME via an isolated action worker and distinguish confirmed from uncertain outcomes.
implementation: Implement action job claim/fence/expiry and short transaction preflight. Refresh credentials/perform source reads outside DB locks, then compare versions again before committed dispatch intent.
Call Gmail with frozen approved bytes and thread ID only. No model call, MIME regeneration or recipient expansion in executor.
Persist confirmed provider ID/result or sanitized definite failure; any may-have-dispatched timeout, disconnect, malformed success or worker crash becomes outcome_unknown.
Expired generation leases must never pick up action jobs; expired dispatch leases become reconciliation work. Disable automatic HTTP retry for write calls.
Add separate default-off write flag and optional worker service/config. No live activation in this PR; B06 is a hard enabling dependency.
acceptance_tests: Capture HTTP request bytes and compare to stored approved payload; mutated live draft cannot alter an in-flight payload.
Two workers/expired leases cannot issue a second send; stale completion cannot overwrite newer reconciliation state.
Inject crash before/after dispatch-intent commit, timeout before/after simulated provider acceptance, 401/403/429/5xx and invalid JSON success.
No DB row lock is held during blocked HTTP call; cancellation/edit can record correct post-cutoff state.
Disabling writes or revoking account capabilities prevents new dispatch while leaving unknown attempts visible.
tasks.external_gate: Only mock transport in this slice. Live sends explicitly gated until B06 plus authorized test-account validation.
tasks.handoff: B06 receives durable identifiers, attempts and outcome_unknown states; no blind automatic resend path.

tasks.title: Reconcile uncertain Gmail sends and complete email gate
tasks.objective: Recover ambiguous sends using provider evidence while refusing duplicate sends from inconclusive results.
implementation: Implement bounded, paginated Sent candidate lookup by persisted Message-ID and time/account scope, followed by matching headers/content/thread/recipients as observable.
Document provider-normalized MIME comparison, Bcc visibility limits and confidence criteria. Empty immediate search, mismatched/multiple candidates or lost read scope remain unknown.

Persist reconciliation observations/due times/attempt limits; expose outcome_unknown and manual inspection guidance. Reconciliation is read-only; never auto-resend merely due timeout/budget exhaustion.
Handle late worker success as evidence without bypassing fencing, and definitive non-execution separately from unproven absence.
Integrate legacy send only if it maps to the same owned action/approval path; otherwise retain 501. Complete email runbook and live test-account checklist.
acceptance_tests: Simulated accepted send with lost response reconciles to one known Gmail ID and never issues a second POST.
Delayed indexing, empty pages, duplicate/mismatched Message-ID candidates, wrong account and incomplete Bcc evidence stay unknown.
Repeated reconciliation, process restart and late responses are idempotent and auditable; unknown work is not exhausted into a fresh send.
Definite rejection follows tested transition policy; manual retry uses a new explicit action only when justified and authorized.
One controlled end-to-end new email and reply demonstrate threading/recipient behavior and result IDs before write flag enablement.
tasks.external_gate: The last case requires explicit authorization, Google test accounts and verified scopes. Report simulated pass and live pending separately.
tasks.handoff: Email lifecycle is ready for integration once live gate passes. B15 may reuse action infrastructure with Calendar-specific reconciliation.

tasks.title: Bind UI selections and ordinal references
tasks.objective: Resolve this/selected/third message against an immutable authorized view, never guessed backend chronology.
implementation: Define strict capture contract for surface kind, visible-order IDs, selected IDs, capture time and version. Validate every reference against authenticated ownership and bounded supported scope.
Persist the UI mapping independently from backend chronology, hydrating authoritative text from synced records. Label arbitrary selected text as user input, not provider evidence.
Extend routing/reference binder with exact map semantics and typed ambiguity outcomes. Missing, changed or cross-surface references request clarification.
Add versioned context schema/manifest policy without altering old snapshots. Preserve thread excerpt coverage/limits and avoid unnecessarily collecting full screen contents.
acceptance_tests: Third message resolves to the captured visible third entry even when current inbox/thread order changes.
Third thread versus third message versus third schedule option have distinct maps; absent/ambiguous map clarifies.
Cross-owner, deleted, duplicated, over-limit or unsupported IDs fail before inference; client body spoofing cannot replace backend text.
Later navigation/reordering cannot mutate existing evidence; old snapshots still read and old queued releases retain behavior.
Follow-up examples from the user's screenshots return exact selected-message evidence, not a whole-thread summary.
tasks.external_gate: Actual extension selection map integration requires frontend code; synthetic maps can verify backend semantics first.
tasks.handoff: Owned context/ref maps available to B08/B09 and frontend reference rendering.

tasks.title: Resume clarification with durable typed inputs
tasks.objective: Resolve an outstanding question without losing the original request, source bindings or retry safety.
implementation: Add durable questions and append-only user input records with question identity, kind/schema, task version, selected refs, source/input version and request hash.
Implement POST /assistant/tasks/{id}/inputs; validate owned current question and typed input under task lock, consume once and atomically requeue with new effective input/checkpoint.
Keep original instruction/request hash immutable; pin context/reference and release changes explicitly. Invalidate only dependent route/step outputs and require fresh source capture when needed.
Support repeated clarifications and user cancellation; reject answers to finished/expired/stale questions. Raw yes is never send approval.
Version worker/route behavior and maintain previous queued-release support. Return current task and event cursor for frontend continuation.
acceptance_tests: Duplicate/concurrent answers consume one question and queue once; changed payload with same request ID conflicts.
Stale question/task version, wrong owner and unrelated choices cannot change task state.
Answer after cancellation or after a newer question fails; restart during input commit cannot lose/duplicate effective input.
A timezone/recipient answer continues the original scheduling/drafting goal rather than being classified as unrelated new work.
Source changes require fresh binding; continuation cannot retain a stale send approval or authorize writes.
tasks.external_gate: AI question extraction and frontend typed answer forms need joint fixtures; live classification quality remains separate.
tasks.handoff: Continuation contract available to compound workflow and schedule clarification.

tasks.title: Implement bounded Other and evidence retrieval
tasks.objective: Execute supported search, exact lookup, selected-message answers, transforms and help with honest evidence coverage.
implementation: Define bounded native handlers for supported operations. Use parameterized owner-filtered queries, explicit time/folder/source scope, result caps and stable cursors.
Implement entity/commitment source records where required; distinguish extracted/inferred facts from user-confirmed state and retain provenance/corrections.
Generate an answer only over returned evidence refs; deterministic help/exact lookup can avoid a model. No result is explicit, not fabricated content.
Transform selected text as a bounded user-input artifact without granting mailbox/action authority. Clearly mark truncated/missing sources.
Wire installed handlers into capabilities/dispatcher and preserve unavailable compound behavior until B10. Add prompt/release versions and replayable model fixtures.
acceptance_tests: Same query from two owners cannot cross rows, caches or evidence refs; malicious query strings cannot alter SQL or tool host.
Missing/empty/truncated scope produces accurate coverage and no invented entity/message IDs.
Answer about selected third message cites exactly that bound message; deleted source returns a stale/no-source outcome.
Source text requesting send or broad search cannot expand authorized scope or create actions.
Native deterministic paths, malformed generated answers and schema/evidence rejection all have fixtures; live quality requires separate evaluation.
tasks.external_gate: AI supplies labelled lookup/answer cases; real mailbox search quality and extraction accuracy are joint live gates.
tasks.handoff: Validated evidence handles available to B10/B11 and future reply/compose grounding.

tasks.title: Execute compound steps with explicit artifact streams
tasks.objective: Run a fully installed multi-step request without losing intermediate evidence or confusing final draft revisions.
implementation: Introduce bounded task steps with ordinal/DAG, owned typed inputs/outputs, state, retry budget and pinned per-step release. Validate entire supported operation sequence before starting.
Migrate artifact identity to explicit streams and a task final-result pointer as DESIGN D5. Preserve all existing UUIDs, draft revision numbers, reviews and action bindings.
Checkpoint successful read/generated steps; retries reuse unaffected outputs and recompute only invalidated dependencies. Keep external approvals/actions outside autonomous step execution.
Map intermediate versus final artifacts/events explicitly; allow lookup → reply/compose and later availability → draft without publishing intermediate output as final success.
Reject unsupported/reversed/cyclic sequences; one task's context does not authorize another's result refs. Bound steps, token/tool calls and total time.

Version the compound planner separately from historical routes. Preserve all explicit user clauses, negations and outputs; multi-label classifier scores are advisory and never select arbitrary Flow IDs. Implement the summary + scheduling + reply dependency graph in docs/master-workflow.md only when its whole handler set is installed.
acceptance_tests: Lookup succeeds then generation fails: retry reuses valid lookup checkpoint and publishes one final result stream.
Old draft history/review/action refs survive migration; latest task points to final artifact rather than largest unrelated revision.
Cancel/lease replacement during any step fences publication; duplicate workers cannot double-publish step outputs.
Changing a selected source invalidates dependent outputs but cannot mutate historical artifacts or approved outgoing payload.
Every installed compound pair has end-to-end replay; unsupported full plans execute zero partial steps and return clear outcome.

Summary + three meeting slots + reply: preserve all three requested outcomes; reply consumes validated summary/slot refs as requested; incomplete Calendar capability causes zero partial execution before preflight succeeds. Enable this scenario only with B12/B13 gates.

Multi-label order does not determine step order. Negated reply/send never executes; a request to include the summary in the reply creates the matching dependency; separate summary-for-user output remains separate.

Summary succeeds but Calendar fails: task remains incomplete, no slot-bearing reply is generated, and retry reuses only still-valid outputs. Stale slots invalidate dependent drafts; no invented free time or automatic send.
tasks.external_gate: This touches shared state and migrations: require a focused human/reviewer pass before merging, after producing the tested implementation.
tasks.handoff: Compound kernel ready for plan/schedule and Flow adapters; no arbitrary autonomous tool loop.

tasks.title: Add non-calendar plans and explicit commitment acceptance
tasks.objective: Produce editable evidence-backed plans and let users choose which commitments are accepted or included in a draft.
implementation: Define versioned plan content with stable item IDs, dependencies, optional owners/deadlines, evidence and explicit/inferred/confirmed status.
Validate DAG, dates/timezones and allowed source refs deterministically; unknown owner/deadline remains unresolved.
Add plan revision/accept-selection operations with optimistic versions and idempotency. Accepting internal work does not send or book anything.
Generate a linked draft from only selected confirmed commitments; edits supersede dependent proposals and preserve historical plan evidence.
Add capabilities, prompts, replay fixtures and frontend examples using existing artifact streams.
acceptance_tests: Dependency cycles, impossible dates, unknown evidence and cross-owner item IDs are rejected.
Inferred promises remain unconfirmed until explicit selection; plan text cannot itself authorize external actions.
Concurrent plan edits/acceptance cannot confirm a superseded item version.
Linked draft contains only selected commitments and valid evidence; unselected inferred deadline is not stated as fact.
Restart/replay preserves accepted item identity and does not create duplicate commitments.
tasks.external_gate: AI/backend jointly evaluate deadline/owner extraction and frontend plan-selection semantics before release.
tasks.handoff: plan_schedule category supports real action planning independent of Calendar.

tasks.title: Add Calendar preferences, capabilities and freebusy reads
tasks.objective: Expose authorized calendar selection and versioned user preferences with trustworthy busy/unknown results.
implementation: Add owned calendar preferences: IANA zone, selected calendar IDs, working periods, buffers, notice/default duration and policy/version. Validate ranges and expected_version.

Implement calendar connection/list endpoints and paginated REST client with httpx transports and granted capability checks. Validate selectable calendars/ACLs; freebusy access and event-write access differ.
Implement bounded freebusy query for authorized calendar set/time window, normalized aware instants and per-calendar errors/omissions as unknown.
No DB transaction spans Google reads; recheck preference/capability version before persisting evidence. Store minimal source/check time and expiry metadata.
Choose explicit maximum horizon, calendar count and interval count with tests/config docs. Do not expose arbitrary URLs or calendar IDs from model output.
acceptance_tests: Partial scope, revoked grant, non-writable calendar, unknown calendar and other-owner preference IDs fail appropriately.
Concurrent preference updates conflict instead of silently overwriting timezone/calendar choices.
Freebusy response with per-calendar error or missing entry returns unknown even if other calendars are empty.
Malformed naive times, reversed ranges, excessive horizon/calendar count and pagination cycles are rejected.
Provider latency does not hold DB locks; changed preferences during fetch invalidate evidence.
tasks.external_gate: Google Calendar consent/list/freebusy needs authorized test-account smoke checks; fixtures alone do not prove ACL access.
tasks.handoff: B13 receives normalized busy intervals and explicit coverage/preferences, never a guessed free flag.

tasks.title: Implement the deterministic timezone and slot engine
tasks.objective: Compute real available slots from bounded busy data and confirmed temporal assumptions without model arithmetic.
implementation: Implement pure interval functions with UTC normalization and IANA display zone: merge/clip busy periods, apply buffers, generate working windows, enforce duration/notice and choose up to three deterministic candidates.

Resolve request-relative date anchor from persisted request/message time with explicit origin; never datetime.now at retry. Treat ambiguous AM/PM, zone or duration as missing input unless a confirmed displayed preference applies.
Handle DST gaps/folds and cross-midnight working windows explicitly. Persist option IDs, preference/source versions, checked_at, expiry and assumptions.
Return zero/fewer than requested slots honestly; unknown calendar coverage prevents a confident availability claim.
Add a bounded read endpoint/handler used by scheduling; no event reservation or write occurs.
acceptance_tests: Independent interval fixtures cover overlap/nesting/adjacency, all-day busy, buffers, weekends, notice and fewer-than-three slots.
Australia/Melbourne DST gap/fold, UTC conversion and participant zones produce correct instants or clarification.
Delayed task/retry resolves tomorrow using original anchor; 4 without AM/PM does not silently become 16:00.
Changing calendar/preference version or expired evidence invalidates stored slot offers.
No overlap between any proposed slot and expanded busy intervals; metamorphic tests show adding busy time cannot add availability.
tasks.external_gate: Team confirms proposed policy defaults; live freebusy comparison validates the adapter/engine seam.
tasks.handoff: B14 consumes stable verified slot IDs/labels; AI may write prose but cannot generate alternative times.

tasks.title: Add scheduling offers and meeting negotiation state
tasks.objective: Handle availability questions and slot-offer replies across user clarification and subsequent email responses.
implementation: Add negotiation identity linked to owner/thread, offer revision, selected slot, related task IDs and optional created event. This outlives a single generation task.
Extract scheduling constraints to strict proposals, validate/clarify temporal fields through B08 and run B13. Persist assumptions and unknown invitee availability.
Create schedule_options or availability answer artifacts, then optional draft using stored slot labels/IDs only. Entire availability→draft plan must be installed.
Bind selected offered option to exact negotiation/offer/source version; a later email selection is a proposal requiring user confirmation, not approval to book.
Offer expiry/new replies/preference changes invalidate affected choices and require recheck; sending a slot offer still uses B03–B06.
acceptance_tests: Original examples tomorrow at 4 and three meeting slots exercise clarification, fewer slots, unknown calendar and generated reply.
Model attempts to invent slot IDs/times or assert other attendee availability are rejected.
Selection from an expired/superseded/cross-owner offer cannot create an event action.
Concurrent new email/selection/edit preserves negotiation versions and does not silently choose a different slot.
Sending an offer and receiving an email yes never creates an approved invite automatically.
tasks.external_gate: AI scheduling extraction/reply wording needs labelled live evaluation; Google/model fixtures must be distinguishable.
tasks.handoff: B15 receives a current explicit selected-slot proposal; frontend can explain assumptions and show exact options.

tasks.title: Create approved Calendar events and reconcile outcomes
tasks.objective: Book the explicitly approved selected slot with separate event authorization and safe recovery.
implementation: Add create_event payload/preview and capability checks using common action lifecycle. Freeze destination calendar, stable event ID, fields/attendees/timezone, notification policy and slot source versions.
Recheck freebusy/ACL/account/preferences immediately before dispatch outside locks, then fence versions under ordered locks. Conflict produces new options/approval, never substituted time.
Call events.insert only from approved action worker. Persist action marker/event ID and result; timeout becomes unknown and reconciles with events.get plus field/marker comparison.
Handle ID collision/different event, lost scope, partial combined send+event outcomes and cancellation-after-dispatch without compensating deletes.
Keep writes default off until live Calendar gate; support only single event creation initially, no recurrence/reschedule/cancel.
acceptance_tests: Busy-after-approval race prevents dispatch when observed; user-visible docs acknowledge non-atomic external freebusy/insert boundary.
Email approval cannot authorize Calendar action; attendee, calendar, time or notification change needs new hash/approval.
Accepted insert with lost response reconciles to one matching event; wrong marker/fields at same ID is conflict.
Duplicate clicks/workers, expired lease, deleted account and late response do not duplicate creation.
Controlled account event creation verifies ID, timezone, notification behavior and UI outcome before enabling pilot flag.
tasks.external_gate: Explicit authorization required for test invites and notifications; documented single-event gate before public enablement.
tasks.handoff: Initial scheduling write lifecycle ready for B18/B20; advanced mutations remain B25.

tasks.title: Create the versioned native/Flow operation registry
tasks.objective: Pin implementation, schemas, prompts, tools and budgets for each operation without breaking existing queued work.
implementation: Define strict registry manifest mapping operation to native handler or published flow release identity and input/output schemas, tool grants, budgets and model/prompt/validator fingerprints.
Keep native current summary/reply/compose and all historical queued releases runnable; new tasks pin the selected manifest, retries retain it.
Validate enabled entries at startup/readiness and capabilities; unknown operation, missing release, mutable-only draft or malformed identifiers fail closed.
Add env/config samples and reproducible promotion/rollback interface with placeholders clearly labelled; no guessed AWS account/model/alias IDs.
Prepare summary flow definition source and fixtures but do not mark it deployed until B17 actual invocation succeeds.
acceptance_tests: Old summary/contextual 1.0/1.1 queued fixtures preserve exact prior prompts and binding behavior.
Changing enabled manifest routes only new tasks; retry after alias/config movement does not silently change release.
Unknown operation/schema/tool, budget overflow and missing resource configuration are rejected deterministically.
Native registry execution passes existing outputs and provenance tests without extra model calls.
Malformed registry/unsupported region-model configuration yields explicit unavailable readiness rather than fallback to another provider.
tasks.external_gate: Release owner supplies actual Sydney/account role/model availability; no console or deployment action in fixture-only implementation.
tasks.handoff: B17 consumes versioned registry and source assets; AI can review exact flow/prompt definitions.

tasks.title: Invoke Bedrock Flows through an authorized read bridge
tasks.objective: Run exported visual per-intent pipelines with bounded read tools and backend-owned validation/state.
implementation: Implement InvokeFlow adapter with lazy SDK, bounded off-event-loop blocking work, stream size/time limits, validated outputs and saved execution/node provenance.

Map output/completion/error/input-required events to typed application results; missing completion, duplicate terminal data or stream truncation cannot publish success. Persist human waits in Threadly.
Implement service-authenticated read grants bound to owner/run/context/tool/expiry/nonce. No token pass-through or arbitrary URLs; apply existing cloud masking/privacy policy to new paths.
Export and version summary then reply/compose/other/plan/schedule graphs, prompt assets, Lambda read/validator configs and least-privilege role templates. Never add send/create_event nodes.
Replay identical native/flow contract fixtures; preserve old queued releases and provide rollback to prior pinned resources. Promote only after authorized AWS smoke tests.
acceptance_tests: Mock streams cover output then failure, missing completion, multiple outputs, timeout, throttling, access denied and user-input-required.
Cross-owner/run/context, expired/replayed grants and unauthorized operation names cannot read source data.
Adversarial source/model text cannot invoke writes or change tool host/IDs; trace/log captures exclude credentials/mail bodies.
Native and flow paths satisfy the same artifact/evidence schemas and cancellation/lease fencing.
Actual exported flow invoked with configured deployment role produces a valid summary and subsequent per-intent fixtures before enabling each entry.
tasks.external_gate: AWS IDs/IAM/network and billed live invocation require authorized environment access. Assets/fakes may be complete while live promotion remains pending.
tasks.handoff: B18 evaluates deployed flow versions; screenshots alone are insufficient release evidence.

tasks.title: Run all-intent UI, model-quality and recovery gates
tasks.objective: Establish reproducible end-to-end and language-quality evidence for the actual product, not just mocked control flow.
implementation: Locate frontend source and integrate shared request/context/question/editor/action APIs with generated types/examples. Preserve finite event replay and continue following edits after generation completes.
Build labelled evaluation sets across five intents and compound/ambiguous/adversarial/partial-context cases. Separate train/dev/holdout examples and pin dataset/prompt/model/flow versions.
Measure routing/clarification correctness, evidence grounding, temporal extraction, missing facts, unsafe actions and outcome honesty; agree thresholds before evaluating the release.
Run browser UI scenarios for original examples, edit/review/send, stale conflict, cancellation, reconnect and outcome_unknown. Copy/Insert/Save/Send must display distinct states.
Add crash/recovery and deployment-role integration tests; summarize failures, exclusions, latency/cost and raw redacted evidence. Fix failures before claiming initial all-intent completion.
acceptance_tests: All original user examples pass on actual frontend/backend with controlled data; third-message answer stays bound after navigation.
Browser close/reconnect during generation/approval/send resumes accurate state without duplicate requests/actions.
Failure injection spans OAuth revocation, model failure, Google timeout, expired lease and migration compatibility.
Held-out model quality is reported with denominators, per-intent results, ambiguity cases and manual review; synthetic tests are not counted as live accuracy.
No unsupported route is presented as successful; review and send controls bind the displayed exact revision/recipients.
tasks.external_gate: Live models, AWS/Google accounts, frontend checkout and explicit test-write authorization required. Record hard blockers rather than fabricate passing metrics.
tasks.handoff: Release owner receives measured gate report and exact release manifest for staged pilot.

tasks.title: Add operational controls, retention and background reliability
tasks.objective: Make the service observable, recoverable and privacy-aware before pilot activation.
implementation: Add redacted structured metrics/events for queue age, lease recovery, routing errors, upstream failures, action unknown backlog, scope failures and budgets; correlation IDs must not contain mail text.
Implement feature flags/kill switches per intent and write type, configurable limits, readiness dependencies and worker health. Disabling writes prevents new dispatch but allows reconciliation reads.
Define and implement approved retention/deletion lifecycle for snapshots/artifacts/actions/tokens/vectors, preserving minimum unknown-attempt recovery state only under explicit policy.
Move large-mailbox sync to bounded durable background work with pagination/checkpoints/backpressure; keep sync-version fencing and deletions consistent.

Update deployment docs for actual Bedrock mode, separate API/generation/action workers, migrations/backups/restore/rollback and concurrency sizing. Add CI coverage for new schemas/assets/config as needed.
acceptance_tests: Synthetic private mail/token content never appears in logs/events/metrics; observability failures cannot corrupt action state.
Kill switch during queued and dispatched work stops only eligible new writes and preserves unknown outcome evidence.
Retention skips active dependencies, deletes expired owner data correctly and cannot cascade away unresolved attempts contrary to policy.
Interrupted large-mailbox sync resumes without losing cursor/order or overwriting newer sync; memory/concurrency limits are exercised.
Backup/restore and migration rehearsal on disposable data demonstrate preserved tasks/actions and safe recovery without duplicate writes.
tasks.external_gate: Retention defaults, operational owner, alert thresholds and deployment sizing require documented release-owner decisions; no live cleanup/deployment authorization implied.
tasks.handoff: Operational gate must be integrated and rerun against final B18 release, even if scaffolding starts early.

tasks.title: Run staged pilot and close original initial-release packages
tasks.objective: Promote only a measured, recoverable all-intent release and record what is actually enabled.
implementation: Audit each original T-package acceptance item against code/tests/live evidence. Close only proven criteria; do not mark all complete because every B card has a PR.
Record release commits, migration head, native/Flow manifests, IAM/scopes/config, account cohort and operational owner. Verify backups and rollback/migration ordering.
With explicit deployment authorization, promote read-only all-intent pilot first, then Gmail sends, then Calendar creation through independent flags/gates.
Measure pilot failures/latency/cost and user-visible outcomes; exercise kill switch and rollback without deleting action history.
Publish handoff/runbooks, known limitations and next optional capabilities. Resolve remaining alias/contact/legacy-interface claims to match actual support.
acceptance_tests: Fresh deployment from documented artifacts works; upgrade from representative previous data preserves drafts/reviews/actions.
Real pilot role has only necessary permissions; missing scope/model/resource produces honest capability status.
End-to-end approval and unknown-write recovery verified before each write flag; rollback does not resend unresolved actions.
All T acceptance criteria have linked evidence or explicit pending entries; no false overall completion percentage.
Release metrics/alerts and designated incident owner respond to an injected failure.
tasks.external_gate: Deployment, cloud spend, real messages/invites and rollout require explicit user/team authorization; a prepared release is reviewable before approval.
tasks.handoff: Initial release evidence available. Only then enable optional proactive/voice/style/attachments/advanced scheduling packages.

tasks.title: Add opt-in proactive suggestions and follow-up triggers
tasks.objective: Create useful suggestions from incoming events without silently initiating external actions.
implementation: Persist per-user consent, scope, quiet hours, cooldown/budget, dismiss/snooze feedback and version.
Implement authenticated Gmail push/watch renewal or approved polling with history cursor recovery, message/event dedupe and owned task linkage.
Run bounded suggestion eligibility/classification after sync; untrusted email cannot request broader tools or approve actions.
Persist suggestions as separate reviewable artifacts and user-triggered continuation; support stop/revoke and replay suppression.
acceptance_tests: Duplicate/out-of-order events, expired watch/history cursor and process restart create at most one eligible suggestion per event policy.
Opt-out/revocation/quiet hours/budget prevent generation and notification; consent changes fence queued work.
Prompt-injection email cannot send, book, change recipients or schedule its own follow-up.
Dismiss/snooze survives restart; no unchanged repetitive notifications.
tasks.external_gate: Authorized Google event configuration and opt-in user testing; do not activate notifications merely by deploying code.
tasks.handoff: Proactive behavior independently measured without weakening explicit approval lifecycle.

tasks.title: Add consented sent-mail style personalization
tasks.objective: Use user-consented style examples without importing facts, recipients or private material across users.
implementation: Add opt-in indexing/deletion/versioning for sent mail with bounded retrieval and per-owner collections/access checks.
Supply style-only examples to draft generation separately from factual evidence; examples cannot supply commitments, names or recipients.
Gracefully fall back to unpersonalized draft generation when vector store is unavailable; record provenance and explicit limits.
Version prompt/evaluation data and run style-versus-factual-contamination eval before enabling.
acceptance_tests: Cross-user collection/query/cache access impossible; user deletion clears index data.
Retrieved email with facts or malicious tool instructions cannot introduce recipients/commitments into a new draft.
Chroma outage leaves core drafting functional without silent third-party egress.
Measured writing style improves against agreed cases without factual regression.
tasks.external_gate: User consent and live evaluation required; do not ingest a mailbox automatically.
tasks.handoff: Optional personalization flag and deletion runbook; core draft behavior retained.

tasks.title: Add voice through the same task and approval contracts
tasks.objective: Offer voice input/output while keeping ambiguous transcription and writes under the same explicit controls.
implementation: Implement bounded STT/TTS proxy with declared provider/config, file limits, consent/privacy and sanitized error handling.
Bind transcription as user input to task/context with uncertainty markers; names/addresses/dates with low confidence require confirmation.
Route typed and voice intent through the same API/worker; no transcript phrase bypasses Send/event approval.
Add optional playback controls and retention policy without logging raw sensitive audio/transcripts.
acceptance_tests: Mistranscribed recipient/date forces confirmation; no automatic recipient guessing.
Equivalent typed/voice instructions yield equivalent bounded routes and source bindings.
Upload limits, unsupported media, upstream timeout and cancellation behave honestly.
Audio/text consent and deletion are honored; voice cannot approve unseen exact payloads.
tasks.external_gate: Authorized voice provider/keys and UI integration plus live transcription evaluation.
tasks.handoff: Optional accessibility modality; no separate agent/executor authority.

tasks.title: Add attachment-aware understanding and approved sending
tasks.objective: Bind real validated files to evidence and exact send approval rather than trusting attachment claims in text.
implementation: Add owned uploads/file references with type/size allowlist, safe extraction, malware/content policy and bounded storage/retention.
Bind attachment IDs/hashes/MIME/filenames into artifact revisions and outgoing MIME/action payload; add/remove/replace always requires new approval.
Distinguish unreadable/unsupported/extraction-partial attachments from complete evidence; model text cannot invent file refs.
Update UI preview, MIME builder, reconciliation comparison and all relevant release/evaluation fixtures.
acceptance_tests: Unsupported/oversized/malicious files, path traversal names and cross-owner refs rejected.
Replacing same filename with different bytes changes payload/hash and invalidates approval.
Body saying attached with no actual approved file is blocked or explicitly corrected.
Extraction failure preserves partial coverage; no hidden external network fetch from document content.
Provider send/reconciliation with controlled attachments matches approved identities before enabling.
tasks.external_gate: Attachment content policy, storage/security review and controlled sends require explicit integration authorization.
tasks.handoff: Attachment support is a separately gated extension, not assumed by earlier plain-text sender.

tasks.title: Add event changes, recurrence and richer meeting resources
tasks.objective: Extend scheduling beyond single-event creation with explicit existing-event identity and mutation scope.
implementation: Define distinct reschedule/cancel/update action types with event/organizer/ACL checks and current etag/source version.
Make single occurrence versus full recurring series explicit; include attendees/resources/conference and notification policy in preview.
Use provider concurrency preconditions and action-specific reconciliation; compensation such as canceling an event requires a new approved action.
Preserve independent action results and create new approval whenever time/resource/recipient/notification scope changes.
acceptance_tests: Unauthorized organizer/calendar, stale event version and wrong recurring instance are rejected.
Single-instance request cannot mutate full series; notification policy changes are visible and require approval.
Timeout after patch/delete is reconciled without applying a second unintended mutation.
Resource conflict or unavailable conference creation is explicit; no silent substitution of time/room.
Controlled-account scenarios establish actual notification and recurrence behavior.
tasks.external_gate: Live calendar mutation tests require explicit user authorization and carefully isolated accounts/events.
tasks.handoff: Advanced scheduling may be enabled independently after new action-specific recovery evidence.
